rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: Wooting's own roadmap still targets 80HE+ ABS/Module delivery for late October 2026, keeping HE/rapid-trigger the dominant switch narrative heading into fulfillment season.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: No fresh MX2A catalyst surfaced this week; sentiment continues its slow recovery from last year's scratch complaints with no new SKU or review driving the number.

rows.name: TMR (Tunnel Magnetoresistance) switches
rows.note: Keychron opened a second TMR campaign, V6 Ultra Hybrid, pairing its Nova Socket magnetic switches with mechanical ones on one PCB, tracking toward a November 2026 ship.

rows.name: Gateron Magnetic Jade Delta
rows.note: No new SKU or colorway from Gateron this week; Jade Delta holds its flagship HE slot but is ceding headline attention to Keychron's new TMR campaign.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: No restock or vendor push found this week; Oil King remains a steady budget-flagship linear with no new catalyst.

rows.name: Durock T1
rows.note: Only a minor Mocha Chocolate colorway listing surfaced this week; no group buy or vendor campaign pushed T1 back into the conversation.

rows.name: GMK CYL Red Devils R2
rows.note: Post-close falloff continues as expected after the Oct 9 group buy close, with no secondary-market or extras news reviving interest this week.

rows.name: GMK CYL Zombie
rows.note: Halloween-themed group buy (Oct 2-31) is mid-run across KBDfans and KeyAtlas listings, with seasonal interest typically building as the close date approaches.

rows.name: DCS Dolch / Molch
rows.note: Divinikey now lists Dolch as preorder with an October 2026 estimated ship date, signalling imminent fulfillment, while the related Molch run still points to Q1 2027.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: No new flagship launch this week; the cohort holds at saturation interest following MoErgo's Go60 debut last week.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: Scattered boutique and OEM activity (Epomaker Tide Alice, Qwertykeys QK Alice Duo) nudges sentiment off its floor, though coverage stays thin relative to split-ergo and 75%.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: Mode Designs' compendium confirms a 2026 Sonnet refresh with five new colorways on the existing Lattice Mount, keeping 75% in the spotlight for premium builds.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: Blaine V2: SE wrapped its group buy in August and the Durock T1 Dark Amber exclusive remains its most recent SKU push, keeping listing volume steady without a new catalyst.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: A 2026 Sonnet refresh teased in Mode's own compendium hints at the next hype cycle, but the post-fulfillment lull from the Summer group buy still dominates this week.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: Confirmed as a proxy for two new Geonworks GMK CYL buys, GORP (Oct 13-Nov 2) and MONO (Oct 30-Nov 30), keeping listing volume high into late October.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: Dual-track momentum continues: Q16 HE 8K fulfillment plus a second Kickstarter, V6 Ultra Hybrid, pairing TMR magnetic and mechanical switches on one PCB.

rows.name: Wooting
rows.note: 80HE+ ABS and Module variants still track toward Wooting's own late-October delivery estimate, with the zinc/knob variant holding at a mid-December estimate.

rows.name: ZMK firmware
rows.note: No major ZMK Studio release this week; adjacent signal comes from Kinesis's Clique firmware update adding longer macros, plus continued MoErgo Go60 ZMK shipments.
